text:
Assistant B is better. It includes the circulation pump and a backup system, both of which matter in a real design, and it covers orientation and tilt. Its workflow is also more specific, with steps for sizing, component selection, installation on the roof, connecting the parts, and testing.

Assistant A opens with an unnecessary disclaimer about not being able to design physical systems. Its workflow is more generic, and it leaves out the pump and the backup. It does mention insulation, cost, and maintenance, which are good additions, but overall it is less thorough on the technical side.

[[B]]
